## Goal

Fix gh-80: a conflict resolved in `merge` (by merging the story branch into the slice) stays resolved when integrate runs again. Repro as a passing regression test.

## Progress

- Fix direction picked: integrate keeps the merge (the first direction in story.md's Wanted). `rebase()` in `packages/adapters/src/git/index.ts` now runs `git rebase --rebase-merges <onto>` (W2 rebase + fast-forward, W4 conflict_loop not spent twice on one conflict). This is the smallest change, and it also covers a merge made by a person. Trade-off: once a slice merged the story branch, the history integrated onto the story branch is not linear.
- Port doc in `packages/core/src/ports.ts` says rebase keeps merge commits.
- Regression test at seam 1: `packages/cli/test/integrate.test.ts` "conflict resolved by merging the story branch stays resolved (gh-80)". It was red before the fix (conflict) and is green after.
